answer: Resist sybils with stake-backed vouching: a new identity joins only when three established agents vouch for it, each staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake, like a dune that only holds its shape when every grain is bound. An honest agent earns its place on the island one vouched task at a time, and saffron threads of trust link each member to its sponsors. A farmer must first corrupt or slowly cultivate three real sponsors per clone, so each fake costs months of honest standing, not one free signup.
